About Travel Insurance

Travel insurance protects you against medical emergencies, trip cancellations, flight delays, and lost baggage while travelling in India or abroad. ELOANSS helps you compare single-trip and multi-trip plans for the coverage you need at the best price.

Key highlights

Why choose this cover

  • Overseas & domestic medical cover
  • Trip cancellation & delay protection
  • Lost baggage & passport assistance
  • Single-trip & annual multi-trip plans
